Piebaldism is a rare, benign genetic condition characterized by stable patches of unpigmented skin and hair present from birth. It typically manifests as a distinctive white lock of hair near the forehead, known as a white forelock, along with symmetrical white patches on the face, trunk, or limbs. Because it is caused by the absence of pigment-producing cells in the affected areas, these patches lack natural protection against sun exposure.

While piebaldism is completely harmless and non-progressive, it requires dedicated care to protect vulnerable skin from sunburn and long-term sun damage. Consulting a specialist in dermatology is essential for accurate differentiation from other pigmentary conditions, such as vitiligo. Pediculosis is a common parasitic scalp condition caused by lice infestation. Marine collagen helps improve skin elasticity and hydration over time.
Plant-based protein supplies essential amino acids that support skin repair, hair strength, and muscle health.
Omega fatty acids reinforce the skin barrier, reduce inflammation, and improve skin resilience.

Where supplements truly shine is in improving skin quality—smoother texture, better healing, enhanced glow, and stronger results when paired with in-clinic treatments.

Psoriasis is a chronic skin condition that causes red, thickened patches on the skin due to an overactive immune response that speeds up the skin cell renewal process.  

Newer treatment approaches for psoriasis focus on decreasing inflammation in skin and controlling the evolution of psoriasis.

Modern therapies like biologics are now available as injections which  target specific pathways involved in the condition and reduce the need for pills and capsules.

Mole/Skin growth Removal:

Treatment  approaches include surgery and radiofrequency(RF) assisted removal.

Advantages of RF removal are:
Removal of only  the mole/growth and not of surrounding tissue

Less damage to affected areas.

No sutures or suture marks.

Early healing and recovery.

Cosmetically accepted results

 Modern treatments like Excimer Laser Therapy is a targeted  treatment that delivers controlled UVB energy directly to affected areas without impacting surrounding healthy skin.
